name: Ques
description: Ques was a swampy planet in the Ques system near the inner border of Hutt Space, and its population primarily consisted of scavengers, such as Dec Hansen. The axton-tarsier, the ferin, the slime crab, and the Snarlap were creatures native to Ques. A school named teacher's cabin was located on Ques.
